# Deploy to Cloud

> Deploy LangSmith agents to LangChain-managed Cloud infrastructure on AWS and GCP.

[LangSmith Cloud](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/cloud.md) is a **managed platform for deploying your agents**. LangChain hosts and operates the [control plane](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/control-plane.md), [data plane](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/data-plane.md), [Agent Server](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/agent-server.md) runtime, and supporting databases on AWS and GCP. Push code to a connected GitHub repository or invoke the `langgraph deploy` CLI, and the platform handles build, provisioning, scaling, and ongoing operations. Deployments come in [two types](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/cloud-platform-features.md#deployment-types):

* **Serverless**: Scales to zero when idle. Suits background agents, testing, and latency-tolerant production workloads.
* **Dedicated**: Stays on and autoscales across replicas. Suits latency-sensitive production workloads.

Agent deployments running on Cloud require a [Plus plan or above](https://www.langchain.com/pricing). Before creating your first agent deployment, verify that your application runs locally with `langgraph dev`. Refer to [Local development and testing](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/local-dev-testing.md).

> [card] [Quickstart](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/deployment-quickstart.md)

To deploy a code-first Deep Agent without standing up your own Agent Server, [Managed Deep Agents](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/python/managed-deep-agents-overview.md) offers a CLI-first managed runtime in public beta.
